coverage_table.path_taken_this_run: CACHE FALLBACK, not the live HTTPS fetch. The published URL 404'd at capture time because an unanchored  rule in pcb-agent/.gitignore had been excluding data/coverage/ from git, so the artefact was never pushed. Fixed in pcb-agent 7400438; the table bytes used here are identical to the committed file. The 404 correctly broke out of the retry loop on the first attempt rather than retrying three times.
coverage_table.log_line: WARNING | Pin coverage fetch failed (404 ...); using cached copy with 156 part(s).

handoff_validation.note: well_formed is a claim about the handoff DOCUMENT only. Buildability is pcb-agent's to decide via compilable.

known_caveats: The architecture agent is non-deterministic. This run produced a DIFFERENT subsystem set from dunkai_real_v2_gpio.json on the same profile: it added an I2C bus between U1 and U2 and chose an 'LED Driver' subsystem where the earlier run chose 'Status LED Output'. Component/net counts are therefore not comparable one-to-one; see the fixture's own counts.
eda.py parse_bom_csv calls the live EasyEDA API per BOM row; packages are not offline-reproducible.

U1 is MIMXRT1172CVM8A, a 289-ball BGA whose pads are named POSITIONALLY (A1, A2, ...). Full pad naming here carries no capability information -- capabilityCheck.js guard 2 exists precisely for this part.

recount_2026_08_22_curated_padcount.why: resolver.js's curated branch built its pinout as `{ok, pins}` with no padCount. capabilityCheck needs padCount to assert completeness, so any unresolved pin on a part with a CURATED pinout degraded from PART_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH to PIN_NOT_FOUND. padCount is now taken from the real footprint (never from the curated pins themselves, which are not required to be exhaustive).
recount_2026_08_22_curated_padcount.result_for_this_fixture: UNCHANGED — every count below is identical before and after the fix.
recount_2026_08_22_curated_padcount.reason_unchanged: No component in this fixture has a curated pinout. The curated table holds exactly two parts (LP103SB6F, HY2111-GB) and neither appears here, so the defect could not have affected these numbers. An earlier report claimed this fix would 'change error codes across the fixture set'; that was an overstatement and is corrected here.
recount_2026_08_22_curated_padcount.measured_with: pcb-agent @ the curated-padCount fix, scripts diag over resolveComponents(allowNetwork: true)
